title: restored data is not visible in the running UI after a successful import — a manual reload is required
dataIntactElsewhere: the same records are present in IndexedDB (4a) and re-export through the app export path (4c); they appear in the UI after page.reload()
mechanism: src/features/data-safety/importFlow.ts applyPlan() refreshes only counts/snapshots/lastBackupAt — the tasks/lists store is never reloaded after applyImport(); tabSync.sweep() only picks up rows with updatedAt > watermark and imported rows keep their original updatedAt
